name: PhotoPrism
tagline: AI-powered photos app for the decentralized web
description: Photo library with automatic tagging, face detection, maps and powerful search — runs anywhere from a Raspberry Pi to a server.
compose:
services:
  photoprism:
    image: photoprism/photoprism:latest
    ports:
      - "127.0.0.1:${{cfg.port}}:2342"
    environment:
      PHOTOPRISM_ADMIN_PASSWORD: "${{cfg.admin_password}}"
      PHOTOPRISM_ORIGINALS_LIMIT: "200"
    volumes:
      - ${{cfg.photos_dir}}:/photoprism/originals
      - ./data:/photoprism/storage
    restart: unless-stopped
